name: Pollen
description: Pollen forecast for alder, birch, grass, olive, mugwort and ragweed, with the ones you're allergic to first and the best hours to go out.

Show today's level for each as low, moderate, high or very high with colours and plant emoji, an hourly chart for the next 4 days, the best and worst hours to go outside, and tips.
